base_id.description: Identifier of the originating clean base pipeline

mutation_type.description: Type of mutation applied (e.g., clean_base, fit_scaler_before_split, etc.)

label.description: Ground truth binary label: 1 = preprocessing leakage, 0 = clean

reason.description: Detailed explanation of why this label was assigned

generator_version.description: Semantic version or commit hash of the generator

source_reference.description: Relative file path or inline key to the source code

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the normalized source code

split.description: Split assignment adhering strictly to base_id grouping

verification_details.description: Quantitative check metrics (e.g. scaler mean comparison, split bounds)
